Session fixtures for internal/graph/session. Generated; never edited by hand.

Source: a raw set of 42 recorded AutoSteer eval runs from 2026-11-12, from three task sets whose run
names start t1-, t1b- and t1c-, one session each, 77 files of store/runs/<sid>/records.ndjson and
steer.ndjson. The raw set and the generator, the script that cuts it, live outside the repository. The
raw set holds prompt words, model words and home paths, and it never enters the repository.
Raw SHA256SUMS.txt sha256: d4967c26349beb83bad1c29c4ad1e866be6ef41b7fa2416215361c11454c4afe

Cut: each line is cut to the decoders' keys, with paths outside the run's tree replaced. The keys are
keys.txt, every json tag recordHead and steerHead read, the one list both the generator and
TestFixtures_KeysAreTheDecodersTags read. A key the decoders do not read is dropped from every line,
whatever its record type.

Replacement rule: an absolute file_path or written_paths entry becomes the marker "/outside" when it
lies under neither the line's project nor its cwd, compared as text both as written and after a
leading /private is removed from all three. No filesystem is read. A path either comparison keeps is
verbatim. The decoder (inProject) places every replaced path outside the project, as it placed the
original, so each line decodes to the same Event. Writes through the /tmp alias of a /private/tmp
project are kept verbatim (29 paths, all in t1c-r6). They decode as outside today, and
TestFixtures_KnownHole_AliasWritesDecodeOutside pins that by name, so a fix that resolves the /tmp
alias turns them inside and must change that test.
Replaced per run (38 in all): t1c-g1 3, t1c-g12 1, t1c-g13 1, t1c-g15 2, t1c-g18 3, t1c-g19 4, t1c-g20 1, t1c-g3 1, t1c-r6 22

Lines: records 12919, steer 487. Bytes: raw 13725008, cut 1445228.
Layout: stores/<run>/runs/<sid>/records.ndjson and steer.ndjson. SHA256SUMS.txt lists each with its
sha256, paths relative to this directory.
Cut SHA256SUMS.txt sha256: 88d4ca402b29f2fb2d3aff428a0d9d92410a4ded229a00145a02cba48ae9f345

Ids: the raw set holds 90 session and prompt ids, and the cut keeps 88: the 42 session ids of the
paths and the 46 prompt_id values of steer lines. Each of the 88 is replaced, in the cut lines and in
their paths, by 00000000-0000-4000-8000-<n in 12 hex digits>, n counted from 1 in the byte order of
the real ids, so a sort over ids keeps its order and every id keeps its length. The other 2 occur only
in records lines, where the cut keeps no prompt_id key, so they are dropped with their key and not
replaced. The table from real id to placeholder is a file kept outside the repository beside the
generator, not with the raw set; the rule above rebuilds it from the raw set, as
TestFixtures_DecodeAsTheRawSet does.

Limit: the recorded runs hold no session record and no ledger line. They exercise writes, Stop
checkpoints, steer lines and prompts only. Verdict, obligations, met_once by ledger and boundaries are
covered by synthetic tests only, until a session is recorded with the ledger writer in place; a
refresh of this set is owed then.
